items.heading: Gallo Pinto Nicaraguense
details: Key ingredients: rice, red beans, onion, bell pepper
Cook rice and red beans separately, keeping bean broth.
Saute onion and pepper until soft.
Combine the rice and beans with the vegetables and bean broth.
Fry until well combined and lightly colored.

items.heading: Vigoron
details: Key ingredients: yuca, pork rinds (chicharron), cabbage salad
Boil yuca until tender.
Fry pork skin until crisp and golden.
Toss shredded cabbage with tomato and vinegar for a tangy slaw.
Layer the yuca, chicharron and slaw together on a banana leaf.
